rust_summary: a crop, stem, cactus, sugar cane, bamboo, mushroom or vine growing or spreading, nether wart or a sweet berry bush ageing, or a hanging mangrove propagule ageing; not sapling trees (a standing mangrove propagule grows a tree the same way) or sculk (`native_block_grow`).
doc_summary: `native_block_grow(dimension, pos, from, to, cancel)` is asked before a growth or spread step at `pos` in `dimension`: the block changes from `from` to `to`, block names with their properties. Set `cancel` to leave it as it is. Covers crop, stem, cactus, sugar cane and bamboo growth, grass spreading onto dirt, mushroom and vine spread, nether wart and sweet berry bush ageing, and a hanging mangrove propagule ageing; not sapling trees (a standing mangrove propagule grows a tree the same way) or sculk. Bundles need "hooks": @API:block_grow@.
